headline: Walnuts Street gets armed — Double Dragon S2 ships
lede: Stage two of the belt brawl lands: thrown knives that come back for more, a whip that rakes the whole line, and barrels you must walk around before you smash them for the steel inside. Plus the deep fix this stage exposed — a freeze where a fighter stood just outside a barrel's reach and nobody could decide which way to step.

notes.text: DOUBLE DRAGON S2 (weapons wall) live at /retrogames/double-dragon: contextual PUNCH (jab / throw / lash), reusable knives, whip multi-hit, solid barrels hiding seeded weapons, one-weapon-in-hand law. ddragoncheck 58/58, three mutants red-with-named, honest autopilot clears 24/24 seeds (PR #2816, issue #2807 to next for S3).

The freeze class: a body standing just outside a prop's radius-extended footprint while its next step lands inside freezes if the dodge re-derives direction per tick or the depth clamp fakes a dodge. Fix shipped as depthSlip: persistent direction, flip on clamp-or-blocked, k-slip fallback — pinned by seeds 7/8/14.

Lane-law from today's race: slot a left its warden target to corpse-resume this lane's claimed issue in the same worktree without posting a claim line. Invisible work yields to the scripted claim; corpse resumes must comment FIRST. Both lanes still shipped (S2 #2816, R-TYPE S1 #2817) with zero double-merge.
QA queue grows: #2819 files the S2 polish pass (blade tumble, whip-crack flash, splinter particles, per-weapon HUD tints). R-TYPE S2 and Contra S4 remain on their stage plans.
